AboutPage.title: A development company for startups.
AboutPage.description: Aldaron designs and builds web and mobile products for startups, from pre-seed to Series A. We work on scope at a fixed price: you know the price before development starts.

1.title: A price fixed before we start
1.description: The firm quote follows a free scoping. It does not change during the project.

2.title: Demos, not reports
2.description: Mockups are approved before development, and the product is presented to you halfway through.

3.title: The code is yours
3.description: Code and accounts are handed over to you at launch.

audience.title: Startups that want a product, not hours.
audience.text: We only work with startups, from pre-seed to Series A. Every project has a written scope and a price fixed at signing.

items.1: Hourly work without a defined scope
